metadata.description: Agent skills for making web games and publishing them on Harmony.

plugins.name: harmony
plugins.description: Skills for web games on Harmony: making a game from an idea, the Harmony SDK, game engines, menus and HUD, saves and progression, settings, sound and music, 3D models, game feel, phones and controllers, peer-to-peer multiplayer, localization, performance, developer tools, testing, store media, and getting a build ready to upload.
